title: Viral Feta Eggs Seem Great But Nothing Beats Apna Amul Cheese
caption:
viral feta eggs seem great but nothing beats apna amul cheese

Nutrition: 
C: 1 | F: 19 | P: 17
Calories: 247  per serving 
Serves 1

how to make them?
20 grams grated cheese
1 tsp chilli oil 
2 eggs 
salt + pepper, if you want 

make a ring with grated cheese, add in some chilli oil, let it sizzle, crack in one or two eggs cook them well and you get this crispy cheese bottom with gooey fried eggs ... enjoy

serve on a slice of sourdough!
